title: Choose the Technologies structure
question: Consiglio: Stack manifest. Risponde nell ordine giusto a "cosa seguo?" e poi "cosa potrei seguire?", riusa le righe del picker della Dashboard senza cambiarle, e la nota 10 of 10 sta proprio sopra i Follow che disabilita. Follow prompt e veloce da tastiera ma toglie le descrizioni; Slot register mette il limite al centro della pagina e perde senso con Pro. Scegline una (o usa steer).

options.label: Follow prompt
options.thesis: The page is a prompt: a large Mono filter line `follow ▌` at the top narrows the Catalog as you type, arrow keys move through matches and Enter toggles Follow; below it, the whole Catalog is an `ls`-style multi-column grid of names with their latest version, followed ones marked.
materials: Mono filter prompt with live match count
ls-style grid of name + latest version
`note:` line for no match and for 10 of 10
options.viewport: Header `technologies` with `7 of 10 followed`; prompt `follow re▌` with `3 matches`; grid of 40 cells in 3 columns, React, Redux and Remix highlighted, followed cells show a check and `Following`.
options.risk: Grid cells have no room for the one-line description, so choosing an unfamiliar Technology needs a hover or its Technology page; a new keyboard model to learn on a page visited rarely.

options.label: Stack manifest
options.thesis: Like a package manifest: `following (7)` comes first as your stack, one picker row per followed Technology with its Following toggle; then `catalog (33)`, a filterable list of the rest in the same rows; `retired (1)` closes the page when present. The quota and the 10-of-10 note sit on the catalog title, where the next Follow happens.
materials: Dashboard picker rows: name, faint facts, Follow Toggle
filter input on the catalog title
`note:` lines for limit, no match and retired
options.viewport: Status line `you follow 7 of 10 technologies`; `following (7)` with React, Vite, TypeScript… each `Following`; `catalog (33)` title with the filter input starting just above the fold.
options.risk: Following a Technology moves its row between sections, which can surprise; the toggle must stay in place until the next visit or filter change.

regions.label: catalog rows: name · latest · description · Follow

options.label: Slot register
options.thesis: The Free limit made physical: ten numbered slots in a Mono register at the top, `[1] react  [2] vite … [8] —  [9] —  [10] —`, each filled slot unfollowable in place; below, the Catalog list whose Follow fills the next empty slot. At ten filled slots the register reads `note: all 10 slots used`.
materials: 10-slot Mono register in two rows of five
Catalog picker rows with Follow Toggle
options.viewport: Register with 7 filled slots and 3 faint empty ones; `catalog (40)` with filter, rows for Angular, Astro, Bun… followed rows show `Following`.
options.risk: Puts the limit at the centre of the page; when Pro removes the limit the register has no meaning, and a retired Technology occupying a slot needs its own mark inside the register.

regions.label: catalog rows: name · latest · description · Follow
